lines.zh: 我贴着地面跑，鼻子在草里。
lines.en: I run low with my nose through the grass.

lines.zh: 四只脚一下下蹬开落叶。
lines.en: Four feet kick the leaf litter back.

lines.zh: 我在树之间穿过去，不减速。
lines.en: I pass between the trunks without slowing.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，肩胛一耸一耸。
lines.en: I keep low, my shoulders rolling.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在软土上留下深印。
lines.en: My claws leave deep prints in the soft earth.
I follow the scent as I go.
I run a circle around a thicket.

lines.zh: 我越跑越快，脚步声很密。
lines.en: I speed up and my footfalls come dense.

lines.zh: 我朝着气味最重的方向去。
lines.en: I head where the smell is thickest.

lines.zh: 我从一截倒木上跳过去。
lines.en: I leap a fallen log.
I run north along the treeline.

lines.zh: 我穿过一片蕨，叶子全倒。
lines.en: I cross a stand of ferns and they all go down.

lines.zh: 我蹲在草丛里，耳朵在转。
lines.en: I crouch in the grass, ears turning.

lines.zh: 草丛里只有我的喘气声。
lines.en: Only my panting moves the grass.
A bird takes flight in the trees.
I run my tongue over my teeth.
I am listening. It is surer than scent.
The hair along my back stands in a ridge.
A gust comes and I lift my head to it.
I stretch my forelegs out slowly.

lines.zh: 林子里到处是我的气味。
lines.en: My scent is all over this wood.

lines.zh: 我把头歪了一下，又正回来。
lines.en: I tilt my head, then straighten it.

lines.zh: 你身上有我闻过的味道。
lines.en: You smell of something I know.
Do not run. Do you think you are faster?

lines.zh: 我的牙咬着东西就不松。
lines.en: Once my teeth close, they do not open.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，腿已经在抖了。
lines.en: Your legs are already shaking.

lines.zh: 我一咬住你，你就动不了。
lines.en: Once my jaws close, you can't move.
One bite and you cannot move.
Your scent is on the bark.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西举得不对。
lines.en: You are holding that wrong.
When I call, you will move.

lines.zh: 你的味道会留在树上很久。
lines.en: Your scent will stay on the trees a long while.
Once I bite, you don't move.
Blood seeps through my coat.
I give half a step and growl.
One leg is lame. I can still run.
You split my ear.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住了森林里的味道。
lines.en: That blow; I will remember the forest's scent.
I shake the blood off.
The smell of blood flattens my ears.
My forelegs hold me up again.

lines.zh: 我咬住你，你就迈不开步。
lines.en: Once I bite, you cannot step.
That smells of blood. Let me look.

lines.zh: 我不吃别人嚼过的东西。
lines.en: I will not eat what another has chewed.
That much meat is one bite.
I smell it raw, not cooked.
Set it down and take two steps back.
I do like the smell of raw meat.
Too old. I leave it.

lines.zh: 这点东西压不住我的饿。
lines.en: That will not touch my hunger.

lines.zh: 我叼起来，找了个背风处。
lines.en: I take it up and find a sheltered spot.
When I finish I will still follow you.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的肩，我几乎没动。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder and I barely shifted.

lines.zh: 我的牙离你的手腕很近。
lines.en: My teeth are close to your wrist.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的爪子抓住了地。
lines.en: At that bump my claws bit into the ground.

lines.zh: 你退后，我的牙就在你腰边。
lines.en: Back off. My teeth are at your waist.

lines.zh: 我转了个身，贴着你过去。
lines.en: I turn and brush past you.
Your shoulder hits my chest.
Once I bite, you cannot run.

lines.zh: 这点撞击，我连头都没低。
lines.en: I did not even lower my head.
Move. I have a scent.

lines.zh: 再撞一下，我就当是挑衅。
lines.en: One more bump and I take it as a challenge.
There is another in this wood.
A stream runs between us.

lines.zh: 我在这边叫，它在那边应。
lines.en: I call on this bank, it answers from the other.

lines.zh: 我们的气味在树干上叠着。
lines.en: Our scent marks layer on the same trunks.
It is a size larger with longer legs.
We never hunt together.
Once it took my kill.
I did not chase. There is always another.
Neither of us crosses that stream.

lines.zh: 叫声隔着一道水，也算说话。
lines.en: A call across water counts as talk.
There is still meat on this bone.
I flip it over with my teeth.
I carry the hide off.
There is blood on the ground. I sniff it.
Not fresh. I drop it.
I bury the bone under a root.
A bright thing. I do not eat it.
I carry it a way.
Paw down, teeth tear.
This bone is mine to gnaw.
Something is breathing behind a tree.
I lift my head and my nose works.
That smell is fresh.

lines.zh: 我朝那个方向走了两步。
lines.en: I take two steps that way.
It has not started running.
Every hair on my back stands up.
Where it stands, there is no retreat.
I show a little of my teeth.
My paws leave the ground first.
Two seconds covers that.
I lick my teeth and take a step.
The moment it steps, I follow.
Run; I am waiting for you to run.
I follow without rushing the pounce.
This wood has no exit.
It heads for the stream.
It weaves between the trees.
I follow the scent trail.

lines.zh: 它停下来，回头看了一眼。
lines.en: It stopped and looked back.
I slipped behind a trunk.
It thinks it has lost me.
I creep along the ground.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸声暴露了位置。
lines.en: Its breathing gives away the place.
I work around downwind of it.
It puts its back to a tree.
That helps it very little.
My paws flatten the grass.
Its hands are shaking.
I do not call. Silence frightens it more.
Two steps left.
It has finally turned around.
And I raised a forepaw.
Only now does it see me.
But far too late.

lines.zh: 它转身往我这边看了一眼。
lines.en: It turned and glanced my way.
It backed half a step into the stream.
I drive into its chest.
My teeth take its arm.
It pulls and cannot break my grip.
A forepaw pins its shoulder.
I pin it down on the dead leaves.

lines.zh: 我把整身的重量压下去。
lines.en: I put my whole weight down.
It punches me. Nothing.
I drag it under the tree.
It cannot call out for this.
My teeth catch in its sleeve.
That one made its legs slack.
I open my jaws and take hold again.
The leaf litter is darkening.
It is still struggling.
I keep low and wait for it to stop.
The wood is quiet again.
I hold it down in the wet mud.
I lift my head with the grip still in my teeth.
Its hands claw at the leaf litter.
I bite down a little harder.
From the tree shadow, I called out first.
I stand at the stream and scent the water.

lines.zh: 我一冲上去，就咬住不放。
lines.en: I charge and latch on and do not let go.
This wood is my ground.
I call once and the birds scatter.

lines.zh: 雾气贴着地面，我的脚在雾里。
lines.en: Mist hugs the ground around my feet.
The ridge on my back settles.
I set off along the scent line.
Something moves deeper in.
First I walk the boundary.
There is a stream on my left.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，先走了半圈。
lines.en: I keep low and walk half the boundary.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的毛，我滚了一圈。
lines.en: Fire caught my coat and I rolled.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，摔得沉。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope and landed hard.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我挣着往岸上爬。
lines.en: Water fills me and I fight for the bank.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀进了树根堆里。
lines.en: The blast threw me into the roots.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进了我的侧肋。
lines.en: An arrow is lodged in my flank.
Strange force pins me.

lines.zh: 饿了两天，我的步子虚了。
lines.en: Two days hungry and my steps falter.
The bolt hits my flank and numbs it.

lines.zh: 扑空了，脚下的地也没了。
lines.en: My lunge missed, and the ground went too.
